label: No. 04 · Craftsmanship
title: The Art of… Leather Works
subtitle: Cowboy hats, the old-fashioned way
image_alt: Oil painting of the leather workshop in the stone barn, a young cowboy shaping a leather hat
intro: Every hat starts as a conversation. We craft cowboy hats in leather, felt and straw by hand, tailor-made — no two the same. Before we begin, we sit down with you in an intake talk to find the style that's truly yours.
more: Besides hats, the workshop makes chaps, belts, wallets, holsters and other cowboy leather works. Contact us for the possibilities.

steps.title: The intake talk
steps.text: Every order starts on request with a conversation, to determine the style of your hat.

steps.title: Leather, leather, felt or straw
steps.text: Together we choose the material, the shape of the crown, the brim and the finishing touches.

steps.title: Made by hand
steps.text: Shaped and finished in our workshop, the old-fashioned way. A craft takes patience.
